source_evidence: Exact player 'I plan to claim these lost ruins for House Vaishnavi once again. There are people above and travelers who will pass and stay, They are to be protected, but free. We will follow the laws of the crown and defend the weak.' V offers substantive voluntary change of duties, protection of residents/travelers, no confinement, Crown law and defense of weak, with intended future claim rather than already conveyed title. Cirren independently Helps by explaining the original sanctuary's purpose from visible dedication and fittings. Predeclared Persuasion advantage +7 DC18 for first warder's provisional allegiance to new duties, actual Python secrets receipt a693f3af135f23b0a9a91eba008c80d1, faces14/14 +7=21 success. The first warder voluntarily kneels and accepts changed purpose as guardian not gaoler, agrees to protect the living and not detain peaceful people; this is a provisional personal service commitment, not supernatural control or guarantee of safe conduct, hereditary proof, title, unrestricted jurisdiction, legal authorization of undead guards, wages or surrender of guarded property. Its two skeletons remain under its ordinary control and obey immediate order to lower weapons and not harm visitors. First warder offers to bring V to fellow warder and explain new charge; second warder's assent and actual disposition unresolved, no new room entry, no initiative, attacks or expenditure. Cirren favors cautious actual verification of ability to keep commitment, particularly around the living; no mandatory destruction of cooperative undead. No clearance certification, property transfer, new appointment of second warder, movement to gallery or copies. Day331~16:35.
